subject.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate chat history integration tests

question: Should a gateway-area reviewer approve this fixture consolidation after verifying that the helper-generated histories preserve the prior session, delivery, and message-tool assertions?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the available PR evidence is a summary rather than independently inspectable after-fix execution output.

options.title: Approve after focused fixture review
options.body: Confirm the shared helpers preserve every prior scenario and accept the test-only consolidation once redacted focused-suite output is available.

options.title: Request narrower evidence first
options.body: Ask for a focused before/after assertion map or terminal artifact before spending maintainer review time on the large test diff.
